game.name: Portal
game.rules:
# **Goal**

Beat the game without scripts, macros or cheats.
This has to be done in one sitting, quicksaves and quickloads are allowed.

# **Version**

For Portal runs the Source Unpack is used which can be found in the [resource section](https://www.speedrun.com/portal/resources), you can do runs on the latest Steampipe but note that not all tricks will be usable (mainly saveglitch).

# **Timing**

Timing begins when the crosshair appears and ends when it disappears after Glados' death.
PC timing is done using In-game time. LiveSplit is highly recommended due to its auto-start/stop and load removal. All runs using in-game time must be using the newest version of SourceSplit.
Console runs are retimed manually by verifiers to be load removed time. Milliseconds are removed from console runs to keep timing consistent.
You are allowed to use the official save from the [resource section](https://www.speedrun.com/portal/resources) to skip the vault.
Pauses have to be timed (Engine Ticks with Pauses in the autosplitter settings).

# **Proof and submitting**

*All runs HAVE to be submitted with some sort of proof in form of a video or demos.* In case of suspicion demos can be requested by the mods.
Videos have to show the full run from start to finish. Video must be hosted on a permanent video platform that embeds on speedrun.com, such as Youtube, or a Twitch Highlight. You may also submit using bilibili, even if it does not embed properly. Temporary platforms such as Streamable or your Twitch VOD are not acceptable. If you are submitting Time without loads with only video proof, the video has to show Livesplit comparing against Gametime throughout the entire run, with at least the first two decimal places visible (1:23.45 is acceptable, 1:23.4 is not).
For runs in the top 25, game audio is required; otherwise, game audio is required if video is the only form of proof.
Demos can automatically be recorded with [Maxxuss' demo plugin](https://github.com/RedHaze/speedrun-demo-record-unified). Runs cannot be submitted with only demo proof if the game is paused mid-run.
Runs that would end up in the top 25 have to be submitted with a live video and demo proof.
Runs that would end up in the top 100 have to be submitted with demo proof, with video proof being optional, but encouraged.
sv_unlockedchapters must be set to 0 before the run starts if New Game is to be used.

# **Whitelist**

Allowed commands/bindings:

- Any bind that is accessible from the menu 
- sv_player_funnel_into_portals binding (checkbox in the menu) 
- toggle_duck binding (default controller bind) 
- cl_showpos 1 
- r_drawviewmodel 0
- binds for sensitivity 
- save/load on one key binding 
- save, fps_max [fps], load on one key binding
- custom named save binds 
- demo plugin related binds 
- toggle binds
- viewmodel_fov
- say related binds (example: bind 7 "sv_player_funnel_into_portals 0; say funneling off")
- gl_clear 1
- net_graph 1
- cl_showfps 1
- sv_autosave 0
- mat_dxlevel 80/90
- echo

You are allowed to use multiple commands on one bind, as well as aliases. Regulations for these can be found [here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1WB4ZWGoOVUBcy-rO2KeUk9WyQhgXM5gDwMRShrDXQp4/edit?usp=sharing), and not following them will invalidate your run.

As of 7/7/2023: SST version 0.5 is now allowed in runs.
You can use it to:

- Set your FOV to any value between 75-120
- Use record to have ongoing demos; instead of speedrun_start / speedrun_segment
- Use it to customize your portal crosshair colors 
- Change DPI scaling 

You CANNOT use it to:

- Have binds that change Portal colors during the run

As of 17/03/2025 Ghost door in 05 is banned, as this is only possible due to actions before the start of the timer. Previous fullgame runs will be grandfathered in, and previous IL runs will be rejected.

Any wall or floor texture changes are not allowed. Other texture and sound file changes are allowed as long as they would not give an advantage. Cosmetic and size changes for fonts in "SourceScheme.res" are allowed. Saving and loading repeatedly to intentionally progress the game without the timer moving is not allowed, however specific strategies that utilize this (such as BSG or save delay) are allowed.

Copymap is banned.

No plugins other than Maxxuss' demo plugin, SST and the input hud plugin are allowed to be loaded during runs.

If you are unsure about a command, bind or other rule please ask via the [discord](https://discord.gg/Tvk9zP3) or the [forum](https://www.speedrun.com/portal/forum).

Tutorials on how to set everything up as well as strats can be found in the [Ultimate Portal Speedrun Guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1H7AHqiSTRzJE2xfqPCGBsUXZay1g9wdUfCbPXoz8S3c/edit) (embedded link).

categories.name: Out of Bounds
categories.rules:
[OoB category rules](https://www.speedrun.com/portal#Out_of_Bounds) apply.  

The following speed caps apply to the very start of all Individual Levels:

-Your horizontal (xy) speed cannot be more than 280 (this is about the maximum speed of a jump, with strafing). 

-Your vertical (z) speed must be between -250 and 150 (This is the speed range when crouch jumping and landing on the same elevation). 

For *escape 01*, you can't have more speed going into the map than crouch jumping off the rail into the trigger would give you (cannot have more than -445.50 z speed. Example of too much speed would be -455.00).

Individual level runs have to be single segment and start on the inbounds level load (e.g. no under or in front of elevator start). You must not start in saveglitch state. No saving/loading. No props from the previous map. You cannot start your Individual Level through New Game. **Demo proof is required to submit** (video is optional).

categories.name: Inbounds
categories.rules:
[Inbounds category rules](https://www.speedrun.com/portal#Inbounds) apply.  

The following speed caps apply to the very start of all Individual Levels:

-Your horizontal (xy) speed cannot be more than 280 (this is about the maximum speed of a jump, with strafing). 

-Your vertical (z) speed must be between -250 and 150 (This is the speed range when crouch jumping and landing on the same elevation). 

For *escape 01*, you can't have more speed going into the map than crouch jumping off the rail into the trigger would give you (cannot have more than -445.50 z speed. Example of too much speed would be -455.00).

Individual level runs have to be single segment and start on the inbounds level load (e.g. no under or in front of elevator start). You must not start in saveglitch state. No saving/loading. No props from the previous map. Obtaining AGSG state is allowed. You cannot start your Individual Level through New Game. 
**Demo proof is required to submit** (video is optional).

categories.name: Out of Bounds
categories.rules:
# **Out of Bounds Rules**

Beat the game, all out of bounds tricks are allowed.

categories.name: Inbounds
categories.rules:
# **Inbounds Rules**

Beat the game without having any props, your camera, placed portals or traveling portals leave the map. 

If any of those conditions are broken, you need to reload a save (however, shooting a portal through oob space that doesn't land anywhere or accidentally doing clipping glitch in maps like 10 is OK).

categories.name: Inbounds No SLA
categories.rules:
# **Inbounds No Saveload Abuse Rules**

Beat the game without having any props, your camera, placed portals or traveling portals leave the map. 

You are NOT allowed to do any glitch/trick/route that requires you to utilize loading (this includes autosaves, map transitions, and New Game).
You're still allowed to use quicksaves, but everything in your run needs to be theoretically possible without using saving/loading. 

If any of those conditions are broken, you need to reload a save (however, shooting a portal through oob space that doesn't land anywhere or accidentally doing clipping glitch in maps like 10 is OK).

categories.name: Glitchless
categories.rules:
# **Glitchless Rules**

Beat the game, using none of the glitches listed below.

Banned glitches include, but are not limited to:
* Any method of going OoB/placing portals OoB, as defined in the [Inbounds rules](https://www.speedrun.com/portal/full_game#Inbounds)
* Any form of Save Load Abuse, as defined in the [Inbounds No SLA rules](https://www.speedrun.com/portal#Inbounds_No_SLA)
* Turret killed Glados
* ABH, AFH, ASH
* Item Climbing or gaining/preserving height from a mid-air prop
* Camera Fly
* Super Object Throw
* Quantum Crouch
* Portal Bumping through objects or entities
* Edge Glitch
* Clipping Glitch
* LAG, AAG, VAG
* Portal Under Door in 09
* Prop and Portal Boosts (accidental boosts are allowed as long as they do not advance you further than possible without glitches)
* Shooting under door at the start of 16
* 11 platform shot
* Item Save Glitch
* Planetary Alignment
* Seamshots

If you are unsure about whether something is allowed or not, message a mod or ask in the discord.

categories.name: Glitchless

categories.name: Inbounds
categories.rules:
[Inbounds category rules](https://www.speedrun.com/portal#Inbounds) apply.  

The following speed caps apply to the very start of all Individual Levels:

-Your horizontal (xy) speed cannot be more than 280 (this is about the maximum speed of a jump, with strafing). 

-Your vertical (z) speed must be between -250 and 150 (This is the speed range when crouch jumping and landing on the same elevation). 

For *escape 01*, you can't have more speed going into the map than crouch jumping off the rail into the trigger would give you (cannot have more than -445.50 z speed. Example of too much speed would be -455.00).

Individual level runs have to be single segment and start on the inbounds level load (e.g. no under or in front of elevator start). You must not start in saveglitch state. No saving/loading. No props from the previous map. Obtaining AGSG state is allowed. You cannot start your Individual Level through New Game. 
**Demo proof is required to submit** (video is optional).

categories.name: Glitchless
categories.rules:
# **Glitchless Rules**

Beat the game, using none of the glitches listed below.

Banned glitches include, but are not limited to:
* Any method of going OoB/placing portals OoB, as defined in the [Inbounds rules](https://www.speedrun.com/portal/full_game#Inbounds)
* Any form of Save Load Abuse, as defined in the [Inbounds No SLA rules](https://www.speedrun.com/portal#Inbounds_No_SLA)
* Turret killed Glados
* ABH, AFH, ASH
* Item Climbing or gaining/preserving height from a mid-air prop
* Camera Fly
* Super Object Throw
* Quantum Crouch
* Portal Bumping through objects or entities
* Edge Glitch
* Clipping Glitch
* LAG, AAG, VAG
* Portal Under Door in 09
* Prop and Portal Boosts (accidental boosts are allowed as long as they do not advance you further than possible without glitches)
* Shooting under door at the start of 16
* 11 platform shot
* Item Save Glitch
* Planetary Alignment
* Seamshots

If you are unsure about whether something is allowed or not, message a mod or ask in the discord.

games.name: Portal
games.rules:
# **Goal**

Beat the game without scripts, macros or cheats.
This has to be done in one sitting, quicksaves and quickloads are allowed.

# **Version**

For Portal runs the Source Unpack is used which can be found in the [resource section](https://www.speedrun.com/portal/resources), you can do runs on the latest Steampipe but note that not all tricks will be usable (mainly saveglitch).

# **Timing**

Timing begins when the crosshair appears and ends when it disappears after Glados' death.
PC timing is done using In-game time. LiveSplit is highly recommended due to its auto-start/stop and load removal. All runs using in-game time must be using the newest version of SourceSplit.
Console runs are retimed manually by verifiers to be load removed time. Milliseconds are removed from console runs to keep timing consistent.
You are allowed to use the official save from the [resource section](https://www.speedrun.com/portal/resources) to skip the vault.
Pauses have to be timed (Engine Ticks with Pauses in the autosplitter settings).

# **Proof and submitting**

*All runs HAVE to be submitted with some sort of proof in form of a video or demos.* In case of suspicion demos can be requested by the mods.
Videos have to show the full run from start to finish. Video must be hosted on a permanent video platform that embeds on speedrun.com, such as Youtube, or a Twitch Highlight. You may also submit using bilibili, even if it does not embed properly. Temporary platforms such as Streamable or your Twitch VOD are not acceptable. If you are submitting Time without loads with only video proof, the video has to show Livesplit comparing against Gametime throughout the entire run, with at least the first two decimal places visible (1:23.45 is acceptable, 1:23.4 is not).
For runs in the top 25, game audio is required; otherwise, game audio is required if video is the only form of proof.
Demos can automatically be recorded with [Maxxuss' demo plugin](https://github.com/RedHaze/speedrun-demo-record-unified). Runs cannot be submitted with only demo proof if the game is paused mid-run.
Runs that would end up in the top 25 have to be submitted with a live video and demo proof.
Runs that would end up in the top 100 have to be submitted with demo proof, with video proof being optional, but encouraged.
sv_unlockedchapters must be set to 0 before the run starts if New Game is to be used.

# **Whitelist**

Allowed commands/bindings:

- Any bind that is accessible from the menu 
- sv_player_funnel_into_portals binding (checkbox in the menu) 
- toggle_duck binding (default controller bind) 
- cl_showpos 1 
- r_drawviewmodel 0
- binds for sensitivity 
- save/load on one key binding 
- save, fps_max [fps], load on one key binding
- custom named save binds 
- demo plugin related binds 
- toggle binds
- viewmodel_fov
- say related binds (example: bind 7 "sv_player_funnel_into_portals 0; say funneling off")
- gl_clear 1
- net_graph 1
- cl_showfps 1
- sv_autosave 0
- mat_dxlevel 80/90
- echo

You are allowed to use multiple commands on one bind, as well as aliases. Regulations for these can be found [here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1WB4ZWGoOVUBcy-rO2KeUk9WyQhgXM5gDwMRShrDXQp4/edit?usp=sharing), and not following them will invalidate your run.

As of 7/7/2023: SST version 0.5 is now allowed in runs.
You can use it to:

- Set your FOV to any value between 75-120
- Use record to have ongoing demos; instead of speedrun_start / speedrun_segment
- Use it to customize your portal crosshair colors 
- Change DPI scaling 

You CANNOT use it to:

- Have binds that change Portal colors during the run

As of 17/03/2025 Ghost door in 05 is banned, as this is only possible due to actions before the start of the timer. Previous fullgame runs will be grandfathered in, and previous IL runs will be rejected.

Any wall or floor texture changes are not allowed. Other texture and sound file changes are allowed as long as they would not give an advantage. Cosmetic and size changes for fonts in "SourceScheme.res" are allowed. Saving and loading repeatedly to intentionally progress the game without the timer moving is not allowed, however specific strategies that utilize this (such as BSG or save delay) are allowed.

Copymap is banned.

No plugins other than Maxxuss' demo plugin, SST and the input hud plugin are allowed to be loaded during runs.

If you are unsure about a command, bind or other rule please ask via the [discord](https://discord.gg/Tvk9zP3) or the [forum](https://www.speedrun.com/portal/forum).

Tutorials on how to set everything up as well as strats can be found in the [Ultimate Portal Speedrun Guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1H7AHqiSTRzJE2xfqPCGBsUXZay1g9wdUfCbPXoz8S3c/edit) (embedded link).
